titleEn: Stair climbers are said to boost fitness, strength and bone health — here’s what the evidence actually says
titleZh: 爬楼机能增强体能、力量和骨骼健康吗？看看证据怎么说
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: The stair climber has seen a huge surge in popularity on social media in recent years. Proponents of the exercise machine rave about its benefits – claiming it can boost cardiovascular fitness, strength and bone health.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，这种爬楼梯器在社交媒体上的人气激增。这种健身器的支持者对其好处赞不绝口--声称它能增强心血管健康、力量和骨骼健康。

paragraphs.en: Evidence shows the stair climber does have many benefits when it comes to health and fitness. While it doesn’t always win out over other types of cardio, there are a few key areas where it has an edge.
paragraphs.zh: 有证据表明，爬楼梯确实对健康和健身有很多好处。虽然它并不总是胜过其他类型的有氧运动，但它在一些关键领域有优势。

paragraphs.en: Cardiovascular fitness
paragraphs.zh: 心血管健康

paragraphs.en: One reason for the stair climber’s popularity is that it’s thought to provide a high-intensity way of boosting cardiovascular fitness.
paragraphs.zh: 爬楼梯器受欢迎的一个原因是，它被认为是一种高强度的方式，以提高心血管健康。

paragraphs.en: But when researchers compared the cardiovascular effects of exercising at the same relative intensity on a treadmill versus a stair climber, they found that those using the stair climbers had lower heart rates and oxygen consumption scores. This meant that stair climbing put less stress on the cardiovascular system, which may ultimately lead to smaller fitness gains.
paragraphs.zh: 但是，当研究人员比较在跑步机上和爬楼梯上以相同相对强度运动对心血管的影响时，他们发现，那些使用爬楼梯的人的心率和耗氧量较低。这意味着爬楼梯对心血管系统的压力较小，这可能最终导致较小的健身收益。

paragraphs.en: That said, stair climbing has still been shown to be just as effective as brisk treadmill walking in lowering blood pressure. A comparison of stair climbing versus treadmill running also showed it improved cardiorespiratory fitness and even promoted similar increases in running performance.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管如此，爬楼梯仍然被证明在降低血压方面与在跑步机上快步行走一样有效。爬楼梯与跑步机跑步的比较也显示，爬楼梯改善了心肺功能，甚至促进了跑步表现的类似提高。

paragraphs.en: So the stair climber is about comparable to running when it comes to improving cardiovascular health.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，在改善心血管健康方面，爬楼梯和跑步差不多。

paragraphs.en: Muscle and strength
paragraphs.zh: 肌肉和力量

paragraphs.en: Another reason the stair climber is preferred by many gym goers is because it’s said to improve muscle health and strength more than other forms of cardio.
paragraphs.zh: 爬楼梯是许多健身爱好者喜欢的另一个原因是，据说它比其他形式的有氧运动更能改善肌肉健康和力量。

paragraphs.en: Indeed, stair climbing has been shown to engage more lower body muscles than walking or running.
paragraphs.zh: 事实上，爬楼梯已经被证明比走路或跑步更能锻炼下半身的肌肉。

paragraphs.en: Stair climbing also engages these muscles for longer and with more forceful contractions than walking. The more a muscle is activated and the longer it is held in one position, the more tension it develops. The greater the tension, the larger the physiological adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 爬楼梯也比走路更长时间和更有力地收缩这些肌肉。肌肉被激活的时间越长，保持在一个位置的时间越长，它产生的张力越大。张力越大，生理适应性越强。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps unsurprisingly is that stair climbing has been shown to cause changes in muscle size that are similar to those seen in people who did conventional strength training using a leg press. These gains in muscle size were also associated with improvements in strength.
paragraphs.zh: 也许毫不奇怪的是，爬楼梯已被证明会导致肌肉大小的变化，这与使用压腿进行传统力量训练的人所看到的变化相似。肌肉大小的增加也与力量的提高有关。

paragraphs.en: However, as this study was only conducted in older adults, it’s not clear if these results would also apply to younger people.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，由于这项研究仅在老年人中进行，因此尚不清楚这些结果是否也适用于年轻人。

paragraphs.en: The changes in muscle size that are seen in stair climbers are greater than those seen in people who do treadmill walking or cycling.
paragraphs.zh: 在爬楼梯的人身上看到的肌肉大小的变化比在跑步机上行走或骑自行车的人身上看到的要大。

paragraphs.en: An additional benefit of the stair climber may come from using the machine backwards. Walking downstairs activates more muscles than walking upstairs does. This is because our muscles have the additional job of braking so we don’t fall or lose balance. This will improve stability while walking.
paragraphs.zh: 爬楼梯机的另一个好处可能来自于向后使用机器。下楼比上楼激活更多的肌肉。这是因为我们的肌肉有额外的制动功能，所以我们不会摔倒或失去平衡。这将提高行走时的稳定性。

paragraphs.en: Joint stress
paragraphs.zh: 接合应力

paragraphs.en: The stair climber is sometimes recommended because it’s said to place less force and stress on the joints and bones.
paragraphs.zh: 爬楼梯有时被推荐，因为据说它对关节和骨骼的力量和压力较小。

paragraphs.en: When you run on a treadmill, the impact force (when your foot hits the ground) is equivalent to around two to three times a person’s body weight. For stair climbing, the impact force is a little lower – around 1.6 times body weight.
paragraphs.zh: 当你在跑步机上跑步时，冲击力（当你的脚撞击地面时）相当于一个人体重的两到三倍。对于爬楼梯，冲击力稍微低一点-大约是体重的1.6倍。

paragraphs.en: Stress, on the other hand, reflects the amount of force that goes through a joint during an exercise. So although stair climbing appears to place less impact force on the joints, a comparison study found the stair climber placed eight times greater stress on the knee than running outdoors on level ground did.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，压力反映的是运动过程中通过关节的力量大小。因此，尽管爬楼梯似乎对关节的冲击力较小，但一项比较研究发现，爬楼梯者对膝盖的压力是在平地上跑步的八倍。

paragraphs.en: This makes sense, as to climb each step the foot needs to be in contact with the stair for a longer period than it would be in contact with the floor while running. So if you want to avoid putting your joints under too much stress, the stair climber may not be for you.
paragraphs.zh: 这是有道理的，因为爬每一步，脚需要与楼梯接触的时间比跑步时与地板接触的时间更长。因此，如果你想避免让关节承受太大的压力，爬楼梯器可能不适合你。

paragraphs.en: However, stress and impact forces aren’t always a bad thing. Evidence increasingly shows that stress to joints and bones may be crucial in maintaining bone health and reducing the effects of osteopenia and osteoporosis. And, despite its lower impact forces, stair climbing has been shown to help control osteoporosis and osteopeania.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，压力和冲击力并不总是一件坏事。越来越多的证据表明，关节和骨骼的压力可能对保持骨骼健康和减少骨质减少和骨质疏松症的影响至关重要。而且，尽管其冲击力较低，但爬楼梯已被证明有助于控制骨质疏松症和骨质疏松症。

paragraphs.en: The stair climber is therefore a great exercise even if you have joint issues or experience some pain. Just remember to start off slowly, doing small amounts of exercise at a time.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，即使你有关节问题或经历一些疼痛，爬楼梯也是一种很好的锻炼。

paragraphs.en: Fat loss
paragraphs.zh: 减脂

paragraphs.en: Another reason the stair climber is popular is because it is claimed that the machine will help you burn more calories – and therefore lose more weight. But the evidence backing up this claim isn’t quite so favourable.
paragraphs.zh: 爬楼梯机受欢迎的另一个原因是，据说这种机器能帮助你燃烧更多的卡路里，从而减轻更多的体重。但支持这种说法的证据并不那么有利。

paragraphs.en: A small study of 30 men compared how many calories participants burned when working out at maximum effort on the treadmill versus on the stair climber. The study found that the stair climber group burned around two calories fewer per minute than they did on the treadmill.
paragraphs.zh: 一项有30名男性参与的小型研究比较了在跑步机上和在爬楼梯上最大努力锻炼时消耗的卡路里。研究发现，爬楼梯组每分钟消耗的卡路里比在跑步机上少2卡路里。

paragraphs.en: The reason for this difference probably lies in the total amount of muscles being recruited during each exercise. When running on a treadmill, the whole body is engaged – including our upper body muscles. But during stair climbing, the upper body muscles are used far less. Many people even use the handrails for safety, so there’s little arm swinging for momentum.
paragraphs.zh: 造成这种差异的原因可能在于每次运动所消耗的肌肉总量。在跑步机上跑步时，整个身体都在运动--包括我们的上半身肌肉。但在爬楼梯时，上半身肌肉的使用量要少得多。许多人甚至为了安全而使用扶手，所以几乎没有手臂摆动来获得动力。

paragraphs.en: So for people whose primary goal is weight loss or weight management, the treadmill may be the more effective option as you burn slightly more calories. Though long-term weight loss success will ultimately depend on maintaining a consistent exercise routine.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，对于那些主要目标是减肥或体重管理的人来说，跑步机可能是更有效的选择，因为你燃烧的卡路里略多。尽管长期减肥的成功最终取决于保持一致的锻炼计划。

paragraphs.en: Despite the hype, the stair climber isn’t that much more beneficial than other types of cardio when it comes to our health and fitness. But it does appear win out over other forms of cardio when it comes to strength and muscle.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管宣传得天花乱坠，但就我们的健康和健身而言，爬楼梯并不比其他类型的有氧运动更有益。但就力量和肌肉而言，爬楼梯似乎确实胜过其他形式的有氧运动。

paragraphs.en: If you’re keen to give the stair climber a try, start out by doing just a few minutes at a lower intensity. As your fitness improves, you can gradually begin boosting the intensity.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你想试试爬楼梯，可以先做几分钟低强度的运动，随着身体素质的提高，你可以逐渐开始增加强度。
